Shop failures cost revenue; isolate checkout from blog plugins.

Coverage

Step plan for “WAF/Cloudflare regels for admin-paden” focused on client panel and account management; adjacent systems only where needed.

Depth for this topic

This long-form guide is written for WAF/Cloudflare regels for admin-paden (slug waf-cloudflare-regels-voor-admin-paden).

Why this approach

Knowledge-base categories: e-commerce-webshops, webshop-beveiliging. Topic key: tz-ec-waf-cloudflare-regels-voor-admin-paden-c4693.

Before you start

  • Recent Installatron or panel backup (files + database).
  • Access to /wp-admin of the correct site.
  • DirectAdmin login for File Manager/PHP/SSL if wp-admin fails.
  • Ability to place a test order or use staging.

Steps

  1. Create a backup; note active payment and shipping plugins for “WAF/Cloudflare regels for admin-paden”.
  2. Test checkout in a private window; note the exact error or hang point.
  3. Exclude cart/checkout/my-account from full-page cache.
  4. Check WooCommerce → Status for errors, webhooks and scheduled actions.
  5. Disable the last changed checkout plugin to isolate conflicts.
  6. Tie this outcome back to topic tz-ec-waf-cloudflare-regels-voor-admin-paden-c4693 in your internal note or ticket.

What not to do

  • Testing a live payment gateway without sandbox.

Recovery path

  1. Restore the previous value you noted for “WAF/Cloudflare regels for admin-paden”.
  2. Restore from backup only if the live state is corrupt — selectively where possible.
  3. Open a ticket with slug/subject, domain and what you already rolled back.

Working agreement

Tip: Keep WooCommerce, PHP and payment plugins on supported combinations.

Note: Caching checkout can cause duplicate orders or empty carts.
